text:
maria_cs: quick alert — between 03:10 and 03:30 UTC we saw a telemetry ingestion gap affecting ~24 onboarding tenants. many are in renewal pilots. i'm drafting outreach. :exclamation:

sam_ops_bot: [ALERT] ingest-service-eu-west returned 503s during config rollout at 03:12 UTC; auto-restart triggered.

oliver_se: does this touch embeddings or generation? any customer-visible model errors or just metrics missing?

jasdeep_eng: technical summary: a config push caused partition assignment drift in kafka->ingest for a subset of tenants. generation endpoints unaffected. some telemetry was backfilled but lost tenant tags so it didn't attach to dashboards. p95 token latency briefly rose but no 5xx on gen.

maria_cs: thanks. i've got a spreadsheet with affected accounts (private). drafting a short note: apology, plain-language RCA, mitigation, offer credit and concierge.

diane_pm: suggested copy: "We experienced a short ingestion gap on <DATE> that may have delayed onboarding progress indicators for some customers. Root cause: internal config rollout affecting partition assignments. We have backfilled data where possible and are offering a 1-month credit + a 7-day onboarding concierge for impacted trials. Full RCA and next steps within 48 hours." keep it concise.

kevin_se: add what customers might see (delayed progress bars, missing example counts) and a booking link + contact. also confirm no customer data or model outputs were exposed.

jasdeep_eng: confirmed: no customer payloads or model outputs exposed. ops rolled back the config, forced rebalance, and reprocessed the 03:10-03:30 window. backfill succeeded for 22/24 tenants; 2 need manual re-ingest (listed in sheet).

maria_cs: good. i'll send to high-touch renewals now (dm + email) with personalization. sending template below — quick review pls:

```
Hi <CustomerName>,

We wanted to let you know about a brief telemetry ingestion gap on <DATE> that may have delayed onboarding progress indicators. What we did:
- Rolled back the config rollout and forced a partition rebalance;
- Reprocessed the affected window and backfilled most missing telemetry;
- Confirmed no customer data or model outputs were exposed.

If this affected your trial or renewal review we are offering a 1-month credit and a 7-day onboarding concierge session. Book: https://redwood.work/enablement or reply here and we'll schedule.

Apologies for the interruption — we will send a full RCA within 48 hours and host office hours at 14:00 & 18:00 UTC today.

Thanks,
Redwood Customer Success
```

maria_cs: sending in 5 unless objections.

kevin_se: :thumbsup: from infra.

diane_pm: approved. add contact link in DM.

maria_cs: sent to high-touch at 08:11 UTC, logged details in sheet. planning a broader automated email at 09:00 UTC.

sam_ops_bot: [DEPLOY] rollback completed 03:22 UTC by jasdeep_eng. backfill job: 22/24 success, 2 pending_manual_reingest.

jasdeep_eng: ETA manual re-ingest for the two tenants ~6 hours. adding preflight checks for future rollouts to detect partition drift.

oliver_se: i'll add a monitoring alert for partition-assignment-imbalance and link the runbook.

maria_cs: after office hours we'll collect feedback and decide on any additional remediation or credit. i'll update thread once full RCA and re-ingest complete. thanks all. :pray:
